calculation.description: Fades the trailing five-session return after scaling by ex-ante 20-session realized volatility. Higher values indicate stronger risk-adjusted short-term reversal potential. Volatility is shifted one session to ensure only completed observations are used.

validation.regime_notes: Validation used the available 15 tradable cross-asset instruments and at least 8 names per date. Daily and longer-horizon results were positive; the reported signal artifact is saved for deterministic audit. Coverage is low in the retrieved aligned panel because the source panel begins later for several instruments, so date-level cross-sectional breadth is more informative than raw cell coverage.
